title: Evaluation of Attribution Bias in Generator-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation by altering authorship metadata labels (e.g., '[Human]' vs. '[LLM]' or real names vs. '[AI]') on input documents in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to measure differences in the LLMs' citation frequency and attribution quality.
